articles.title: BP (LSE:BP.) Completes 65% Castrol Stake Sale
articles.summary: BP (LSE:BP.) has completed the sale of a 65% stake in its Castrol lubricants unit to infrastructure investor Stonepeak. The transaction gives BP cash proceeds that management plans to apply toward reducing the group’s outstanding debt. Castrol is set to operate as an independent business, with BP retaining a minority shareholding in the lubricants specialist.
